label: Aero Sleeper Semi
generated: measured off the rig source by hand-transcription with per-value provenance; no generator in the rig

frame.origin: ground-centre of the body footprint (bumper excluded from the centring; z=0 is the road)
frame.at_rest: every value here is at susF=susR=0, doors and hood shut, skirts fitted, BOBTAIL (no trailer). See TOW for the coupling.

pivot_px._note: the road cell — a bare tractor fits it; model z=0 projects to the pivot row in all 8 facings

VARIANTS._what: NONE. One PART toggle covers the fleet builds.

skirts._note: aero side fairings between the axles. false bares the frame, both fuel tanks and the battery box; NO published z changes and the painted bbox is IDENTICAL either way (the skirts sit inside the fender/cab silhouette — the harness asserts it).

collider_bbox._note: the painted front fenders are the widest hard point (2.54 m). Mirrors reach 2.96 over — add 0.21 m per side above z 1.64 if they must be solid.

ground_clearance_m.source: tandem diff tubes r 0.17 centred z 0.50 (buildWheels)
ground_clearance_m._note: mudflaps are rubber; the skirts are painted composite at 0.22 m — a kerb strike is gameplay's call, the rig draws neither bending

BODY.provenance: BODIES.aeroSemi + G; mirrors from buildCab boxes |1.38..1.48|

CAB._what: a two-seat sleeper cab: high flat floor, buckets, a 1.63 m bunk room behind the seats — one shell, no partition.

floor.provenance: buildCab floor slab at G.cabFloorZ; headliner z 2.72

bunk._note: one undivided berth across the sleeper. Occupancy, rest mechanics and privacy are gameplay's call.

keep_clear._note: sweep of the free edge about the hinge axis; the collider is the arc, not the leaf

boarding._note: two tank-top steps then the high floor — see STEP; the 1.15 m sill is the tallest climb in the pack

reach_point._note: outside the swept disc; NOT tested against ground colliders

mirror.rides: the CAB (A-pillar arms), not this door

TOW._what: the tier's whole point: this tractor COUPLES. Trailers are separate bodies with kingpin anchors; the GAME articulates the pair about the coupling point.

ramps._note: approach ramps angle down aft — back under a trailer nose and the kingpin rides up into the slot

swing_clearance.nearest_obstruction: the cab back wall (y -0.88); the side extenders sit 1.83 m from the kingpin — farther, despite looking closer
swing_clearance.swing_basis: a 2.44 m-wide trailer with the pack's 0.90 m kingpin set: r = sqrt(1.22^2 + 0.90^2)
swing_clearance.verdict: FULL JACKKNIFE CLEARS — by 4 mm. Keep the pack's trailers at the 0.90 m set, or re-run this arithmetic before coupling anything else.
swing_clearance._note: the game owns the articulation; the rig renders a bobtail tractor and publishes the numbers

glad_hands.lines_to: the trailer nose — air and electrics; the lines are drawn slack to the catwalk
glad_hands.attach: trailer-side anchor pairs with this point

deck._note: grid-plate catwalk between cab and fifth wheel, where the lines are worked

STEP._note: two tank-top treads per side under the doors — 0.44, 0.80, then the 1.15 m floor. Frame parts: they ride the suspension, never the hood.

SUSPENSION.applies_to: the whole body group (frame, hood clip, cab, fairing, fifth wheel, deck) — the wheels do NOT move
SUSPENSION.consequence: every polygon in CAB, THRESHOLD and TOW rides that dz — including the COUPLING POINT: a coupled game re-reads fifthWheel z under load rather than caching 1.18.
SUSPENSION.provenance: build() dz(y), verbatim; axR is the tandem CENTRE (-2.30)

WHEELS._note: roll is per-CORNER (wFL wFR wRL wRR, REVOLUTIONS) — each tandem SIDE shares its corner's roll across both axles, and each dual pair shares its wheel's. One revolution (3.142 m) closes to 0.15% of painted px: 29.008 tread stripes of 0.1083 m plus 10-fold lugs.
WHEELS.provenance: G.frontWX / dualXi / dualXo / axF / tandA / tandB / wheelR / tireW — exact

STEERING.sense: +1 = full LEFT lock; the nose swings toward -x
STEERING.ackermann: outer = atan(1/(1/tan(inner) + track/wheelbase)), front track 1.68 m, wheelbase 5.25 m (to the tandem centre)
STEERING.axis: vertical, through each front wheel centre — no kingpin offset, caster or scrub radius is modelled

turning_radius_m._note: geometric, at full lock, BOBTAIL. A coupled trailer tracks inside this arc; off-tracking is the game's arithmetic.

swept_envelope._note: at full lock a front tire corner keeps 38 mm inside the painted fenders — the fenders are the collider width and the lock stops at 32deg to keep it that way.

STEERING.does_not: yaw the tractor. STEERING turns the wheels; YAW turns the machine. A turning tractor wants both — and a coupled trailer wants its OWN yaw.

HOOD.rides: the whole FRONT CLIP: raked hood, cheeks, both fenders and arches, liners, grille, headlamps — one group
HOOD.stays: bumper, frame, engine, CAB (doors, mirrors, steps), fairing, fifth wheel, wheels
HOOD.extreme: at hood=1 the hood nose reaches y 4.72 (0.60 m past the bumper) and the cowl edge rises to z 2.76. Do not open against a wall.
HOOD.provenance: buildHoodClip part() + rotX about G.hoodHinge; G.hoodDeg = 72

YAW.what: heading between the eight facings. The model turns about z before projection under a FIXED key, so the shading is rebaked for the new heading — this is not a rotated sprite.
YAW.pivot: unaffected; the origin projects to the published pivot at any yaw
YAW.frame: yaw is a RENDER param, not geometry. Every metre in this file is in the machine frame and does not move with it.
YAW.gameplay: a heading is dir*45 + yaw. A COUPLED PAIR is two headings: tractor dir*45+yaw and trailer dir*45+yaw, hinged at the coupling point — the articulation angle is their difference, and TOW.swing_clearance is its limit.

exhaust_tip._note: under-frame, street side — smoke/heat FX attach. NO chrome stacks on the aero tier.

fuel_tanks._note: hidden behind the skirts on the fleet build; skirts:false bares them

fairing_top._note: beacon/aerial attach on the fairing crown

frame_end_lamps.kind: red — the bobtail tail lights; a coupled trailer brings its own

INTERACT._note: pull the release from the street side; the coupling itself is backing under the nose
worked from the catwalk or the curb side of the deck

_interact_notes.reach_point: a request, not a promise — a ground-level standing spot derived from which face the item is on. NOT validated against terrain, kerb or another vehicle.
_interact_notes.visible_facings: the near-side test paint() uses: a feature with outward normal n is listed for facing d when nx*sin(d*45) + ny*cos(d*45) < -0.3, edge-on excluded. Top faces are visible at all eight.

_excluded.CLEATS: not a hull. The fifth wheel is TOW — a coupling, not mooring.
_excluded.walkable_roof: the fairing crown at 3.85 m has no rail and no route up. The CATWALK (TOW.deck) is the only intended standing surface off the ground.
_excluded.fuel_fill: no filler necks or caps — the tanks are in ATTACH.fuel_tanks.
_excluded.exhaust_stack: no chrome stacks — the aero tier runs under-frame after-treatment. The stacks are the CLASSIC tier's cue.
_excluded.rear_bumper: none. The frame ends bare with two lamp clusters; the trailer brings the ICC bar. Bobtail rear-end collision is a frame strike.
_excluded.sleeper_interior: the bunk is a slab; no cabinets, curtain or interior interactables are modelled.
_excluded.plate_and_wipers: no licence plate, wipers, aerial or decals. At 32 px/m they are 1-3 px and were left out of the bake.
_excluded.spare_wheel: no spare is modelled, slung or otherwise.

_confirm.coupling_owner: the rig renders a BOBTAIL tractor and publishes the coupling point; pairing, articulation, off-tracking and jackknife physics are the GAME's. Pair anchors().fifthWheel with the trailer's kingpin anchor and hinge there.
_confirm.swing_margin: full jackknife clears the cab by 4 mm — with the pack's 0.90 m kingpin set and 2.44 m trailer width. A wider trailer or a shorter set contacts the cab; re-run TOW.swing_clearance before coupling anything foreign.
_confirm.coupled_height: the trailer deck rides at 1.18 m when coupled — and at dz(y=-2.40) under suspension. Re-read the anchor, do not cache it.
_confirm.deck: the catwalk is published as geometry (1.10 m, grid plate). Whether a player stands there to work the lines is unruled.
_confirm.bobtail_lamps: the frame-end lamps are the only tail lights bobtail. A coupled trailer's lamps take over; nothing in the rig wires that.
_confirm.hood_discipline: nothing couples the hood to motion or coupling state. Opening the clip under a trailer nose is geometrically possible and visually wrong; the rig will not stop it.
_confirm.mirror_collider: BODY.collider_bbox stops at the fenders (2.54 m). The mirrors reach 2.96 m over — the widest mirrors in the pack; decide before a lane squeeze.
_confirm.skirt_rule: skirts:false changes 1690 pixels and ZERO bbox — pack once, toggle freely.
_confirm.fifth_wheel_slide: the plate is FIXED at y -2.40 (0.10 aft of tandem centre). Real plates slide for weight distribution; this one does not, and nothing in the sidecar pretends otherwise.
_confirm.steering_and_yaw: STEERING moves the wheels only; YAW moves the machine. Nothing couples them — and nothing couples the trailer; see YAW.gameplay.
